title: How Large Solid Wood Furniture Is Packed, Crated & Shipped | WRYDECO
meta_description: Learn how large solid wood furniture is securely packed in custom timber crates, shipped via freight, and safely brought inside your home on delivery day.
body_html:
When investing in substantial handcrafted solid wood furniture—such as multi-tiered branch display shelves, organic pedestal tables, or large platform beds—understanding how oversized pieces are packaged, transported, and delivered into your home is essential for a smooth arrival experience. Safe delivery of heavy solid timber requires three specialized logistics protocols: custom-built reinforced wooden crates that prevent transit impact, trusted freight carrier transport with liftgate support, and clear homeowner preparation for curbside delivery and indoor carrying.

WRYDECO is a US-operated furniture brand creating handcrafted natural wood furniture with master artisans in Vietnam, offering verified designs ranging from $576.90 for architectural floating shelves up to $4,047.95 for grand multi-tier sculptural living room branch displays. Every oversized order includes complimentary standard shipping worldwide. Because solid hardwood furniture is substantially heavier and more valuable than flat-packed particleboard furniture, our workshop employs museum-grade timber crating and freight protocols to guarantee that your piece arrives in flawless condition.

How are large solid wood pieces protected with custom wooden crating and cushioning?

Unlike mass-market furniture that ships in lightweight cardboard boxes susceptible to crushing, WRYDECO large solid wood pieces—such as the compare specifications for Handcrafted Solid Wood Tree Branch 3-Tier Wall Shelf for Living Room ($1,697.95 to $4,047.95)—are individually crated in custom-built timber enclosures before international dispatch. Each crate is constructed to the exact dimensional contours of the specific furniture model, eliminating internal movement during intermodal transit.

Before crating, every wooden surface is wrapped in non-abrasive protective foam to safeguard the hand-rubbed hardwax oil finish. High-density edge guards cushion all outer branch limbs, live edges, and corners against pressure points. Moisture-absorbing desiccant packs are sealed inside heavy vapor-barrier stretch film to maintain stable relative humidity during overseas ocean freight or air cargo transport. The outer crate is assembled with solid wood framing battens and reinforced plywood sheathing, creating a rigid protective cage that withstands external impact and heavy freight stacking.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305844883546_13973761-d1c1-4484-95ee-411814cdac89.jpg]

Keep these four packaging checkpoints in mind when anticipating your furniture shipment:

  • Crate construction: heavy-duty timber framework with reinforced exterior plywood panels protects against punctures.
  • Multi-layer interior wrapping: vapor barrier wrap, shock-absorbing foam, and corner guards shield natural wood grain.
  • Climate control protection: desiccant packs regulate ambient humidity within the sealed crate during transit.
  • Fastener security: outer crate panels are secured with steel screws or banding designed for easy disassembly with a cordless drill.

What happens during freight carrier transport, transit tracking, and liftgate arrival?

Oversized and delicate solid wood furniture—including multi-piece units like the compare specifications for Handcrafted Natural Wood Tree Branch Floating Shelves for Living Room ($1,598.00 to $3,948.00) and substantial casegoods like the compare specifications for Rustic Solid Wood Round Pedestal End Table for Living Room Decor ($1,294.00 to $3,149.00)—ships via specialized LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) freight carriers rather than standard parcel couriers. Freight transport ensures that your wooden crate travels on dedicated pallets, handled exclusively with pallet jacks and forklifts to prevent rough parcel conveyor handling.

Once your piece completes workshop crafting and departs our logistics hub, you receive an automated shipping notification with your freight tracking number and carrier contact details. As the shipment approaches your local delivery terminal, the carrier's dispatch team contacts you directly to schedule a dedicated delivery window. On delivery day, the freight truck arrives equipped with a hydraulic liftgate, which lowers the heavy wooden crate from the truck bed smoothly to ground level at your curbside or driveway threshold.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305844621402.jpg]

Review these four freight delivery stages before your shipment arrives:

  • Dispatch notification: receive tracking details and carrier assignment once your crate departs fulfillment.
  • Pre-delivery scheduling: the freight carrier calls or texts in advance to confirm an appointment date and arrival window.
  • Liftgate unloading: standard delivery includes hydraulic liftgate lowering to ground level at your driveway or curbside.
  • External package inspection: examine the exterior wooden crate for any signs of transit damage before signing the delivery receipt.

How do handcrafted furniture designs compare across crate weights, dimensions, and prices?

Crate dimensions and freight weight correspond to the physical scale and timber density of the furniture piece. Compact floating shelves like the compare specifications for Solid Wood Arched Floating Two Tier Wall Shelf ($576.90 to $1,326.90) ship in manageable crates weighing under 45 pounds, while multi-tiered branch displays and upright pet furniture like the compare specifications for Handmade Natural Wood Parrot Play Stand for Small Birds ($2,061.00 to $2,430.00) travel in substantial timber crates weighing between 65 and 180 pounds.

Verify these four ordering and freight considerations before placing your order:

  • Confirm that your driveway or building entrance can accommodate a commercial freight delivery truck.
  • Ensure you have a cordless screwdriver or drill with Philips and Torx bits available on delivery day for quick uncrating.
  • Note that complimentary standard shipping covers curbside or threshold freight delivery only.
  • Contact WRYDECO customer support at support@wrydeco.com if your address has narrow access lanes or flight-of-stairs restrictions.

Who is responsible for carrying the piece inside your home on delivery day?

A frequent question from first-time furniture buyers is who carries the large wooden crate inside the home. Under standard freight logistics, complimentary standard shipping includes curbside or driveway threshold delivery with liftgate service. The delivery driver is responsible for lowering the crate from the truck bed and positioning it on the ground at your driveway or curb.

Freight drivers are not authorized or insured to enter your private residence, carry heavy crates up interior staircases, uncrate furniture, or remove packing debris. Therefore, the homeowner is responsible for carrying the unboxed furniture pieces inside their home. Because our custom crates open quickly by backing out outer screws, we recommend opening the crate outdoors on a clean tarp or garage floor and carrying the individual, protected wooden components inside one by one with a family member, neighbor, or hired local moving helper.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305911992410.jpg]

Follow these four practical tips for moving your furniture indoors safely:

  • Uncrate outdoors or in the garage: remove the crate lid and unscrew side panels so you only carry the furniture itself indoors.
  • Never lift alone: solid hardwood is dense and heavy; always use a two-person team with work gloves for secure grip.
  • Clear the interior pathway: prop open entry doors, remove hallway rugs, and protect floor surfaces with moving blankets.
  • Keep foam wrap intact: leave protective foam wrapping on delicate branch tips until the piece reaches its final room position.

What delivery timelines, 6-hour cancellation rules, and warranty policies apply to WRYDECO orders?

Every WRYDECO solid wood furniture piece is individually handcrafted to order by skilled artisans, ensuring meticulous attention to structural joint integrity, grain matching, and final finish sanding. All eligible orders worldwide include complimentary standard shipping directly to your residential address. Order fulfillment follows a two-stage timeline: estimated processing and crafting takes approximately 15 to 20 business days, followed by an estimated 3 to 5 business days in transit with trusted freight carriers, resulting in a total estimated delivery window of 18 to 25 business days. Because crafting and carrier routing are dependent on hand production and customs procedures, these timelines represent careful estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates.

Because each piece enters personalized production preparation shortly after checkout, customers enjoy a 6-hour Golden Window immediately following purchase. During these initial 6 hours, you can request 100% free order cancellation or modify size, finish, and address details without penalty. Once the 6-hour window expires, orders enter active workshop crafting and cannot be canceled or modified. Upon delivery, inspect packaging thoroughly; returns are accepted within 30 calendar days for items that arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect, with store-paid return freight and documentation provided. Returns for change of mind are not accepted. Every furniture piece includes a 1-year limited warranty covering defects in materials and craftsmanship under normal residential use.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305846325338_b713a307-593b-42d6-97d0-7e17686bf2de.jpg]

Review these four purchasing policies before placing your handcrafted furniture order:

  • Take advantage of the 6-hour Golden Window after ordering to make any final adjustments to dimensions or finish.
  • Note that complimentary standard shipping delivers to your doorstep or curbside and does not include inside carrying or assembly unless arranged.
  • Plan a two-person team or coordinate professional assembly for installation day to position the heavy solid wood components.
  • Reach out directly to support@wrydeco.com with your order number whenever you have questions or custom inquiries.

Worked example: planning delivery day clearance and two-person carry path for a 65-inch shelf crate

Suppose you have ordered a 65"W x 65"H x 7"D Handcrafted Solid Wood Tree Branch 3-Tier Wall Shelf for a second-floor master study in a residential home.

  1. Calculate crated dimensions and weight: The exterior timber crate measures approximately 70 inches long by 70 inches wide by 12 inches high, with a total gross crated shipping weight of approximately 115 pounds. The unboxed solid hardwood shelf assembly weighs approximately 68 pounds.
  2. Determine outdoor uncrating strategy: Attempting to carry a 70" x 70" timber crate up a standard 36-inch residential staircase is physically impossible without tilting and risking wall impact. Instead, plan to receive the crate on your driveway, remove the top plywood panel with a cordless screwdriver in 5 minutes, and lift the 68-pound solid wood shelf out of the crate. With the crate sheathing removed, the shelf framework comfortably passes through standard 32-inch and 36-inch doorways.
  3. Map the indoor carry path: Measure stairway width (standard 36 inches), hallway turning corners, and overhead light fixtures along the route to the second floor. A two-person team carrying the 68-pound unit vertically on edge navigates standard 36-inch stair treads and 90-degree landing turns with ease, preserving interior drywall and door casing finishes.

Double-check your delivery preparations with these three final verification steps:

  • Have a cordless drill with Philips/Torx bits and a crowbar or pry tool ready in your garage on scheduled delivery day.
  • Inspect the exterior crate panels upon arrival and note any transit punctures or scuffs on the carrier's delivery receipt before signing.
  • Retain all inner packaging foam until the shelf is safely anchored into structural wall studs in its final position.
